title: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Large Cans
h1: The 3 Best Electric Can Openers for Large Cans
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for electric can openers for large cans, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at electric can openers for large cans using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Hamilton Beach Smooth Touch Electric Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Extra-tall opening capacity, Push-down lever, Opens standard, pop-top, and extra-tall cans.
strengths: Extra-tall capacity handles large coffee and juice cans that standard openers can't clamp
Corded motor maintains torque through a full large-can cut without slowing
Also handles standard and pop-top cans, so it's not a single-purpose unit
limitations: Does not reach true #10 restaurant-size can height
No auto-stop, so listening for the motor to finish is the cue on a longer cut
features: Opens standard, pop-top, and extra-tall cans

products.name: Cuisinart Deluxe Electric Can Opener CCO-50N
products.blurb: Key specs: Quality-engineered motor, Single-touch automatic operation, Nonslip wide base.
strengths: Stronger motor keeps a consistent cutting speed on larger, heavier cans
Nonslip base keeps a heavier full can stable and centered during the cut
Automatic stop removes the guesswork on a longer cut cycle
limitations: Not rated for true extra-tall coffee-can height like the Hamilton Beach
Costs more than the Hamilton Beach at typical pricing

products.name: Black+Decker Spacemaker EC600 Can Opener
products.blurb: Key specs: Under-cabinet mounting, Corded motor, One-touch lever.
strengths: Corded motor keeps steady torque through a larger can's cutting cycle
Freeing the counter gives more room to position a tall or heavy can underneath
Fixed mounting keeps the unit stable under the added weight of a large can
limitations: Fixed under-cabinet height limits maximum can height more than a countertop unit
Smaller owner base than the two market leaders
features: Frees counter space for maneuvering large cans

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
